gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Redux spreads its geometric letters wide, each curve entered with a big visible lead-in, while Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified. Its terminals stop far from the stem.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-thai-loope: Contemporary and wide-set, Redux gives each curve a generous entrance stroke up top. Noto Sans Thai Looped follows with tall, bold-looking lowercase and spacious curve endings, so the two feel like a showpiece and a sturdy partner.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Clean and modern, Noto Sans Vithkuqi keeps its letters open. Redux, spaced wide with solid stems, sits above it, and the two share a roomy, unhurried look.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Chalky, heavy, almost hulking: that is the lowercase here. Noto Sans Wancho leaves a wide gap in its e, while Redux above it stretches wide with gentle weight shifts in its bowls.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-traditional-nus: Noto Traditional Nushu reads like a broad-nibbed pen that never curls shut. Redux, wide-set and gently stemmed, sits over bowls that fill the line, and the two feel friendly together.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-pathway-extreme: Wide, geometric and a little showy, Redux leads with a big entrance into every curve. Pathway Extreme follows with stubby ascenders, a big x-height and clear openings, so enlarge it only if the text feels small.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-preahvihear: Wide letters, big curve entrances, a lofty stance. Preahvihear opens its letter mouths like a pried oyster shell, so shrinking Redux would lose its wide, geometric presence next to that tall body.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-pt-sans-caption: Redux stretches its letters wide and gives every curve a big visible entrance, with a mellow modulation under the eye. And PT Sans Caption, with its big-bodied lowercase and inviting open bowls, handles what follows.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-puritan: Wide spacing and a big entrance into each curve define Redux, a geometric display face with modest weight change. Puritan follows with rounded forms that stay open to the side, and its oversized counters keep the reading easy.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-questrial: Redux lets its letters spread wide, each curve entered with a big visible lead-in and stems close to hairlines. Questrial then runs flat and stencil-cut, with short stalks, so leave its size alone.
